items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 5.1% in 1985 to 11.3% in 2025 across 291 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

1 of 291 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 13 for salt or chloride; 36 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
1 of 291 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 11 of 11 high-need ones have none.
